deadline_note: Proposed internal checkpoints; not confirmed instructor deadlines.

milestones.title: MS1 — Project foundation
milestones.description: Agree shared interfaces, protocol and metadata; establish C++17/CMake layout, CI and review workflow.

milestones.title: MS2 — Separate module demonstrations
milestones.description: Each role demonstrates its module independently with real transport or agreed fakes.

milestones.title: MS3 — Reliable communication
milestones.description: Four-peer membership/chat, reliable UDP and basic chunk transfers work under loss and reordering.

milestones.title: MS4 — Complete distributed file sharing
milestones.description: Verified distributed storage, replicated metadata, joining storage and multi-source download failover work.

milestones.title: MS5 — Final verification and demonstration
milestones.description: Four-computer/eight-file and fifth-peer demos, failure tests, report and final release review. I44 is optional.

issues.title: Repository folders and root CMake configuration
checks: Create the proposal's apps and library folders with public include/, src/ and tests/ directories.
Build with C++17 using target-based CMake; common is header-only INTERFACE.
A clean configure and build succeeds; generated build output is ignored.

issues.title: Shared C++ interfaces and common types
checks: Agree ITransport, IPeerDirectory, IChunkStore and IChunkFetcher with all consumers.
Use fixed-width IDs, endpoint/session types and virtual interface destructors.
Document asynchronous completion, callback lifetime, cancellation, queue-full and failure results; compile a fake consumer.

issues.title: Protocol envelope and operation sequences
checks: Specify the proposed 48-byte header, offsets, network byte order, numeric message types and payload layouts.
Define JOIN nonce/session handshake, ACK/SACK semantics, sequence wraparound and 1200-byte datagram limit.
Freeze CRC variant with a known vector; document malformed and stale-packet rejection plus join/chat/chunk flows.

issues.title: Manifest and replica metadata specification
checks: Define file ID, total size, chunk size/count, final chunk length and full/chunk SHA-256 hashes.
Distinguish desired replica placement from confirmed verified holders.
Specify paged catalog/manifest/HAVE metadata with bounds and consistency rules.

issues.title: Project board, labels, milestones and issue/PR templates
checks: Create five dated milestones and assign all proposal issues to the correct role.
Provide task and PR templates with owner, deadline, dependencies, files and acceptance evidence.
Create a project board with Backlog, Ready, In progress, In review and Done; show assignee, target date and priority.

issues.title: M1/M2 code owners, Copilot and main branch rules
checks: Set Musab-Farooq and hamzi802 as code owners with write access.
Require a PR, one independent human/code-owner approval, resolved conversations and passing build/test checks where supported.
Request Copilot as additional review where available; do not count its approval as human approval. M1 reviews M2; M2 reviews M1.

issues.title: Initial CMake build and CTest CI workflow
checks: Run configure, build and registered CTest tests on pushes and PRs.
Fail CI when no tests are registered; keep token permissions read-only.
Show a passing clean build and a failing-check example; module owners add behavioral tests as features arrive.

issues.title: Packet encoding, decoding and validation
checks: Round-trip every header field and payload using explicit serialization, not raw C++ memory.
Reject short/oversized packets, invalid lengths, bad CRC and unsupported versions.
Add boundary and known-vector tests, including network byte order.

issues.title: UDP socket wrapper and two-process demo
checks: Wrap POSIX UDP socket lifecycle with automatic cleanup and nonblocking reads.
Demonstrate two real processes sending/receiving encoded packets.
Handle bind/send/receive errors and establish that only the transport reads the socket.

issues.title: Peer table and /peers command
checks: Store peer ID, session, display name, endpoint, last-seen time and state.
Add four fake peers, reject duplicate identity entries, remove one and display the right list.
Test an empty list and join/update/remove behavior without real networking.

issues.title: Bootstrap JOIN, WELCOME and HELLO
checks: Join through any existing peer using JOIN/WELCOME/HELLO and a correlated join nonce.
Handle repeated/lost join messages safely, reject stale welcome replies, and synchronize paged peer lists.
Use fake transport first, then verify four real peers can agree on the group without a permanent coordinator.

issues.title: Fixed-size chunking and SHA-256 hashing
checks: Split a binary 2 MiB file into 128 chunks of 16 KiB; preserve a short last chunk.
Use a maintained SHA-256 implementation behind a reusable wrapper.
Reconstruct identical bytes; test empty/small inputs and corrupted data according to documented input policy.

issues.title: Local chunk store and manifest generation
checks: Implement IChunkStore for verified binary chunks keyed by file ID and chunk index.
Generate complete manifests with full-file and per-chunk hashes.
Keep originals/downloads separate; reject invalid paths/indexes and handle missing chunks/disk failures.

issues.title: Fake transport, peer directory, store and clock
checks: Provide fakes implementing the four agreed service contracts and a controllable clock.
Simulate delivery, loss, duplicate/reordered replies, unavailable sources and queue-full outcomes deterministically.
Give M2/M3/M4 small usage examples; no real sleeps or sockets are required for unit tests.

issues.title: Chunk scheduler demonstration using fakes
checks: Schedule different chunks from two simulated remote sources with bounded concurrency.
Remove one source before reply and choose a confirmed alternate holder.
Log request/chunk/source IDs and completion; demonstrate explicit failure when all copies are unavailable.

issues.title: ACK tracking, retries, backoff and failure reporting
checks: Track unacknowledged packets per peer session/stream and process ACK/SACK correctly.
Retry with documented timeout/backoff and retry limits; ACKs must not require ACKs.
Test lost data, lost ACK, exhausted retries and nonblocking success/failure reporting.

issues.title: Sequence ordering and duplicate suppression
checks: Deliver once and in order per sender/session/stream using a bounded reorder buffer.
ACK duplicate packets again without duplicate application delivery.
Test reordering, gaps, duplicates and sequence wraparound; define behavior on unrecoverable gaps.

issues.title: Separate streams, bounded queues and receive window
checks: Maintain independent control/chat and bulk-file sequence/queue state.
Respect advertised receive windows and return queue-full instead of unbounded buffering.
Under file load demonstrate that control/chat traffic and timers still make progress.

issues.title: Heartbeat, LEAVE and crash detection
checks: Send heartbeats, track last-seen times and notify consumers on membership changes.
Process graceful LEAVE and mark a timed-out peer suspected/unreachable, not proven crashed.
Use a fake clock to test delayed/lost heartbeats, reappearance and session restart behavior.

issues.title: Ordered four-peer group chat
checks: Fan out CHAT to active remote peers using ITransport; show local messages once.
Preserve sender/session identity, per-sender order and duplicate-free display.
Demonstrate four-peer chat and visible delivery failure; do not promise global order across senders.

issues.title: Two-holder placement and storage invariant checks
checks: Choose two distinct holders per chunk using an agreed sorted membership snapshot and deterministic file offset.
Verify no peer holds every managed chunk for supported files and peer counts.
Test four/five peers, insufficient peers and short-file limits; never infer actual holders from desired placement.

issues.title: Chunk request/data/error and block reassembly
checks: Implement CHUNK_REQUEST, CHUNK_DATA and CHUNK_ERROR with request/file/chunk/block identity.
Split storage chunks into payloads fitting the datagram budget; reassemble with duplicate-safe block tracking.
Bound allocations, serve chunks through IChunkStore, reject stale/invalid blocks and report missing/busy/error cases.

issues.title: Real UDP loss, duplicate and reorder tests
checks: Inject reproducible recoverable packet loss, duplication, reordering and lost ACKs between real processes.
Verify ordered single chat delivery and correct block transfer with fixed seeds.
Record permanent-failure and bounded-memory evidence; fakes alone do not satisfy this issue.

issues.title: Initial chunk distribution and storage confirmation
checks: Use M4's transfer service to seed chosen replica holders.
Advertise holders only after hash verification and successful storage confirmation; transport ACK alone is insufficient.
Prove two distinct verified replicas per chunk before declaring distribution complete; preserve original files.

issues.title: Replicated catalog, manifests and holder records
checks: Replicate paged catalog/manifests and confirmed HAVE records to other peers.
Merge/retry metadata safely and validate sizes, indexes and page counts.
After publisher departure, a survivor can locate metadata and confirmed chunk sources.

issues.title: Joining-peer metadata and storage handoff
checks: Give a newcomer the catalog, manifests and holder records; compute its desired storage share.
Fetch assigned chunks through IChunkFetcher and verify/store them before advertising.
Keep old good replicas until replacements are confirmed; test interrupted handoff.

issues.title: Parallel download using two remote sources
checks: Keep overlapping chunk requests active against at least two distinct remote holders.
Use bounded queues and fair source scheduling; reuse already verified local chunks.
Logs prove source overlap and correctly ordered output assembly.

issues.title: Source failover retaining verified progress
checks: On timeout, source departure or corruption, reassign unfinished work to another confirmed holder.
Preserve verified progress and ignore late replies from cancelled/replaced requests.
Finish after one source crashes; report unavailable chunks when all copies are lost.

issues.title: Per-chunk and complete-file hash verification
checks: Verify every completed chunk against its manifest and final output against the full-file SHA-256.
Reject corrupt chunks and retry a valid replica without declaring false success.
Test corrupt/truncated data, final-hash mismatch, output path validation and disk-write failure.

issues.title: File commands and responsive chat during transfers
checks: Implement /share, /files and /get by calling M3/M4 services; /quit exits cleanly.
Wire one nonblocking event loop for CLI, transport, timers and service callbacks.
During a large transfer demonstrate responsive chat, heartbeats, help and actionable errors.

issues.title: Restart, stale-packet and queue-failure handling
checks: Reset peer-pair state on accepted new sessions and reject stale packets/ACKs.
Handle queue limits, retries exhausted and disconnect callbacks consistently across consumers.
Test either peer restarting, old WELCOME/ACK/data arrivals and cancellation cleanup.

issues.title: Four-computer eight-file demonstration
checks: Run the same application on four LAN computers with separate data directories.
Each of four members shares two files of at least 2 MiB: eight files total.
Capture commands, membership, hashes, placement and successful retrieval evidence.

issues.title: Bootstrap departure continuity test
checks: Start four peers via A, then gracefully stop A.
Verify B/C/D keep communicating and can discover files without contacting A.
Record repeatable steps and actual results with no hidden server dependency.

issues.title: Fifth-peer joining and storage acquisition test
checks: After the original bootstrap leaves, join E through a surviving peer.
Verify all active peer lists converge and E receives catalog/manifests and its verified storage share.
Show the peer list grows without recompilation or a fixed four-peer array.

issues.title: Replica placement and publisher-departure tests
checks: Before failure, verify two distinct confirmed holders per chunk and no complete managed copy.
Stop the publisher; prove metadata survives and remaining holders support retrieval when copies remain.
Report degraded replica counts after failure honestly; optional repair is separate from required download failover.

issues.title: Two-source download with a crashed source
checks: Start overlapping requests to two remote peers and terminate one during transfer.
Finish through surviving replicas while retaining verified work.
Provide source/request logs and matching final SHA-256 as evidence.

issues.title: Full loss, corruption and failure test suite
checks: Cover packet/ACK loss, duplicates, reordering, corruption, missing replicas and restarts.
Include queue exhaustion, malformed metadata and disk-write failures without unbounded allocation.
Document deterministic seeds, expected/actual outcomes and clear known limitations.

issues.title: Clean-clone build and registered-test verification
checks: From a fresh clone, run the documented CMake configure/build/CTest commands successfully.
Verify dependencies and library versions are documented and no generated/local data is needed.
CTest must run real module/integration tests, not just the initial skeleton smoke check.

issues.title: Transport and protocol report section
checks: Explain serialization, sessions, ACK/SACK, ordering, retries, streams and bounded buffers.
Include packet examples, design assumptions, limitations and linked test evidence.
Walk M2 and M4 through the interface and answer retry/restart questions.

issues.title: Membership and chat report section
checks: Explain peer records, bootstrap independence, joins, heartbeats, suspected failures and chat fan-out.
Show command/event-loop wiring and distinguish per-sender order from global order.
Link demonstrations and give another teammate a walkthrough of the module.

issues.title: Storage and placement report section
checks: Explain chunking, hashes, manifests, confirmed holders and deterministic placement.
Show replica/no-complete-copy proofs and safe join-time handoff.
Document originals/download exceptions, degraded operation and publisher-departure evidence.

issues.title: Transfer report, final assembly and demo guide
checks: Explain transfer request identity, reassembly, parallelism, failover and integrity checks.
Assemble all four report sections, diagrams, build instructions and actual test evidence.
Provide a timed demo sequence and troubleshooting steps understandable by every member.

issues.title: Final integration review and release tag
checks: Review all mandatory acceptance criteria and unresolved defects with M2.
Require independent human approval on final changes and passing CI.
Tag an agreed passing commit; record exact SHA and limitations without claiming optional work is required.

issues.title: Optional: restore lost chunk replicas
checks: After mandatory failover is complete, detect under-replicated chunks and choose replacement holders.
Copy from surviving verified replicas through M4's service, confirm storage, then publish new holders.
Preserve no-complete-managed-copy constraint where feasible; document insufficient-peer/all-copies-lost cases.
